summary: Domain Manager feature fully tested. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all 4 tabs (Overzicht, Site Domeinen, Subdomain Routing, Cloudflare), dialogs, and interactions working correctly. System routes present, domain configs with CNAME verification working, toggle functionality operational.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend domains.py: Well-structured with proper auth helpers (require_system_admin, require_network_admin), clean CRUD operations, DNS verification using dnspython
Frontend DomainManager.js: Clean React component with tabs, properly handles all domain types (koodh/custom), uses data-testid for all interactive elements
Cloudflare API integration is prepared but not actively calling Cloudflare - placeholder for API token as expected
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created temporary domain configs and routes, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Domain Manager feature is complete and working. 4 tabs: Overzicht (overview stats), Site Domeinen (domain configs per site), Subdomain Routing (clara/login/global routes), Cloudflare (API config). 2 domain configs exist: radiogroep.koodh.com (koodh type, verified) and zt.radiogroep.be (custom type, pending verification). 3 system routes seeded. Cloudflare API prepared but not connected (placeholder).
